dedupe_keys.name: direccion de meteorologia e hidrologia paraguay daily river levels conventional and automatic stations

description: Paraguay's meteorology and hydrology directorate (DMH) publishes river level records from its own stations and from partners under cooperation agreements with the Navy, the national navigation and ports administration (ANNP), the environment secretariat and the public works ministry. The page for conventional stations on the Paraguay River lists, for each station, the date, the day's level, the daily change and the historical minimum and maximum with their dates; on 27 September 2026 it showed readings of 26 September 2026 for stations from Puerto Ladario, Puerto Murtinho and Cáceres in Brazil down to Isla Margarita, Fuerte Olimpo, Bahía Negra, Vallemi and Concepción. A second page lists automatic stations. The data are updated daily. Coverage is the Paraguay River and other rivers observed by DMH and its partners. Access is online and free on the DMH website; each station links to more detail. Caveats: no bulk download was seen, and historical extremes are given as single values. Simulation uses: stage records and extremes for flood and low-water hazard analysis of river ports and riverside infrastructure. Related records: SNIH Argentina (data-argentina-snih-national-hydrological-network) and ANA HidroWeb (data-brazil-ana-hidroweb-hydrometeorological-network).
